desc: Prove and document the reduction: f(L,R) is the number of consecutive-value components, equivalently distinct values minus adjacent present pairs.
Implement the O(N) last-occurrence vertex-edge solution maintaining sum_x last[x] and sum_x min(last[x], last[x+1]) while scanning right endpoints.
Validate the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases such as N=1, all equal values, all distinct consecutive values, and missing intermediate values.
